title: Fractal Waterbending
body:
Flow like water with abilities focused on healing, crowd control, and versatile combat using collected water sources.
10+ powerful and immersive water bending abilities. 

Water benders collect water by sneaking near water, ice, snow, mud, or plant blocks. Collected water powers their abilities.
/b choose
Requires Fractal Bending Core.
Slot-based bending with combos
1	Surge	Launch a steerable water bolt that follows your aim as it flows.
2	Water Manipulation	Raise a flowing water glob; punch for water whip attack.
3	Octopus Form	Surround yourself with lashing water tendrils. AOE damage and lava cooling.
4	Ice Spikes	Erupt a line of ice spikes that freeze and damage.
5	Ice Prison / Frost Breath	Punch: encase foe in ice (3 block range).
 Hold shift: frost breath that slows and chills.
6	Tide		High-damage water tide that pulls enemies toward you.
7	Healing Waters	auto-healing while selected. Heal yourself and nearby allies in or near water.
8	In Tune	combat pulse on shift/punch. Regen and water breathing in water, speed near water.
9	Water Spout	Ride a column of water. Needs a water source below. Flight up to 16 blocks.
